notes.title: Update 1.11g (Dialog improvements for German version)
notes.notes: The update of the German version to 1.11g includes some minor bugfixes, balancing adjustments and a revision of various dialog passages, which should further improve the dialog flow of the German version of the game. The English version was already on 1.11g, including all bugfixes and balancing adjustments.

notes.title: Major-Performance Update (V1.10)
notes.notes:
- The whole game was optimized and will now run with significant more FPS

- The movement-direction of all Ringmenus can now be inverted

- Pentagrams don't set the marker for a cleared area anymore, Each of those areas has now an additional chest with a marker.

- Fixe some minor Bugs with NPCs and mapping

notes.title: Major Balancing Update V1.08
notes.notes:
Some major improvements regarding the game progression and difficulty level

-Enemy-Respawn Option now available in the game (available in Asgars Castle)
- several previously hidden places are now visible from the start (this will help getting progress without having to search the map in the Levels <20)
- Experience from quests increased below Level 50
- Summonings have now ~20% Health
- Traps now reduce Bloodpoints instead of Health when "Auto-Healing" is off
- Using a battle stance in battle doesn't require an additional selection of the character anymore
- Several adjustments of enemy, character and item stats

notes.title: Feature-Update (Version 1.07)
notes.notes: - The Difficulty of the game can now be changed in  Asgars Castle

notes.title: Version 1.06
notes.notes:
- Fixed all Bugs regarding the Werwolf and the main Story
- Fixed "strange" cutscenes of the main story when the party order was changed manually
- Some balancing changes at the beginning of the game

notes.title: Bugfix V1.05
notes.notes:
Update V1.05:

- WASD als Steuerung hinzugefügt
- einige Gegner am Anfang des Spiels geschwächt (Soldaten, Elras)
- Performance auf der Weltkarte verbessert
- Einige kleine Anzeigefehler im Menü korrigiert
- Werwolf-Fehler bezüglich des Kampfes am Anfang auf der Brücke im ersten Dungeon behoben
